svg.title: CI/CD pipeline for DL models with canary
svg.desc: GitHub Actions tests and builds model images. Argo Rollouts shifts ten percent of requests to the candidate through Traefik. The analysis Job checks the split and measures candidate inference. Passing promotes the candidate. Failing restores all traffic to the baseline.

g.text: CI/CD pipeline for DL models with canary
Lab 82.1 · Test and package a model, then promote it only after a 10% canary passes its SLO.
Learn data engineering by building it
